CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: feat(job): per-job leveling -- each job levels independently (GFD-124433). p.charXP is now a live alias into a new p.jobXP map, switched via switchActiveJob/loadJobXP (both unit-tested). Persists via IDUNA's new character_job_levels table. Two twin bugs fixed: stale p.charJob.MainLvl on job switch, missing applyJobStats on telnet-reconnect. 11 new tests. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
